description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory that implements a cache decorator storing definitions in PHP memory. It provides methods to add, set, replace, and retrieve cached definitions, mainly used for unit testing or environments with many configuration objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory
classes.description: A cache decorator class that stores definitions in memory, extending the base decorator to add in-memory caching capabilities.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache and stores it in the internal definitions array.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets (updates) a definition in the cache and internal array.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache and internal array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a definition from the cache if it exists; otherwise, loads it via the parent method and stores it.
